_note: v2.8 35 G7 (R13): the story blocks a request actually carries, read from the outgoing /generate body (dry runs skip interceptors, ST script.js:4562-4564). A normal turn carries every story block set at send time, the pacing hint and the check outcome included; a swipe of the round's last reply carries every block set at its send time and the pacing hint (the check outcome belongs to the turn's first reply, so it is not set for that swipe); an impersonate carries the kept blocks and neither declared-withhold block (INJECTION_REGISTRY carry). The swipe's lore-select window drops the reply being replaced (R14) is a jest case (loreSelect.test.ts), since lore select needs the judge. No-model lane, fetch stub as plan 60 B10. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-35-g7-shipped-blocks.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (rt.turnBlocksHeld()) rt.clearPrivateInjection(); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const NL = String.fromCharCode(10); const HINT = 'Pacing: '; const DECIDED = 'The story has already decided these outcomes.'; const WS = new RegExp('[' + String.fromCharCode(32, 9, 10, 13) + ']+', 'g'); const norm = (text) => String(text).replace(WS, ' ').trim(); const blocks = () => Object.entries(SillyTavern.getContext().extensionPrompts ?? {}).filter(([key, value]) => key.startsWith('story_orchestrator') && String(value?.value ?? '').trim() !== '').map(([key, value]) => ({ key, value: norm(SillyTavern.getContext().substituteParams(String(value.value))) })); const textOf = (body) => typeof body?.prompt === 'string' ? body.prompt : Array.isArray(body?.messages) ? body.messages.map((m) => (typeof m?.content === 'string' ? m.content : JSON.stringify(m?.content ?? ''); if (url.includes('/api/backends/') && url.endsWith('/generate')) { let body = null; try { body = JSON.parse(String(init?.body ?? 'null')); } catch {} const text = norm(textOf(body)); const live = blocks(); seen.push({ live: live.map((b) => b.key), present: live.filter((b) => text.includes(b.value)).map((b) => b.key), missing: live.filter((b) => !text.includes(b.value)).map((b) => b.key), pacing: text.includes(HINT), outcome: text.includes(DECIDED) }); const reply = 'SO-G7 stub reply ' + type + ' ' + seen.length + '.'; return new Response(JSON.stringify({ choices: [{ text: reply, message: { content: reply } }], results: [{ text: reply }], content: reply }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }); } return original(input, init); }; let error = null; try { if (type === 'swipe') { const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; const row = ctx.chat[id]; if (!row || row.is_user) throw new Error('swipe: the last message is not a reply'); const before = Array.isArray(row.swipes) ? row.swipes.length : 1; await ctx.swipe.to(null, 'right', { source: 'swipe_picker', forceMesId: id, forceSwipeId: before, forceDuration: 0 }); } else await ctx.generate(type); } catch (e) { error = String(e?.message ?? e); } finally { globalThis.fetch = original; tg.textgenerationwebui_settings.streaming = streaming; host.setOnlineStatus(status); } const box = document.querySelector('#send_textarea'); if (box) { box.value = ''; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800)); if (!seen.length) throw new Error(type + ': no generation request reached the stub' + (error ? ' (' + error + ')' : '')); return { type, requests: seen, error }; }; globalThis.__g7 = { real, blocks }; return { ready: true, mainApi: SillyTavern.getContext().mainApi };

steps.eval: const live = globalThis.__g7.blocks().map((b) => b.key); if (!live.includes('story_orchestrator_pacing')) throw new Error('no pacing hint is set: ' + live.join(', ')); if (!live.includes('story_orchestrator_check_outcome')) throw new Error('no check outcome is set: ' + live.join(', ')); return { live };

const r = await globalThis.__g7.real('normal'); const missing = r.requests.flatMap((q) => q.missing); if (missing.length) throw new Error('normal: story blocks set but not in the sent request: ' + missing.join(', ')); if (!r.requests.some((q) => q.pacing)) throw new Error('normal: the pacing hint did not reach the sent request'); if (!r.requests.some((q) => q.outcome)) throw new Error('normal: the check outcome did not reach the sent request'); return { type: r.type, requests: r.requests.length, blocks: r.requests.map((q) => q.present), withheld: r.requests.map((q) => ({ pacing: q.pacing, outcome: q.outcome })), error: r.error };

const r = await globalThis.__g7.real('swipe'); const missing = r.requests.flatMap((q) => q.missing); if (missing.length) throw new Error('swipe: story blocks set but not in the sent request: ' + missing.join(', ')); if (!r.requests.some((q) => q.pacing)) throw new Error('swipe: the pacing hint did not reach the sent request'); return { type: r.type, requests: r.requests.length, blocks: r.requests.map((q) => q.present), withheld: r.requests.map((q) => ({ pacing: q.pacing, outcome: q.outcome })), error: r.error };

const r = await globalThis.__g7.real('impersonate'); const held = r.requests.filter((q) => q.pacing || q.outcome); if (held.length) throw new Error('impersonate: a declared-withhold block reached the request: ' + JSON.stringify(held)); const missing = r.requests.flatMap((q) => q.missing); if (missing.length) throw new Error('impersonate: a kept block is missing from the request: ' + missing.join(', ')); return { type: r.type, requests: r.requests.length, blocks: r.requests.map((q) => q.present), withheld: r.requests.map((q) => ({ pacing: q.pacing, outcome: q.outcome })), error: r.error };
